name: j2-channel
prompt: Top-down macro of a dark circuit board, painted in the same comic-hardware illustration style as the references (one warm key light, ink-lined edges, black-green fibreglass): one long straight horizontal light-guide channel runs the full width across the middle third of the frame, a recessed groove edged with polished gold rails and filled with clear dark resin, unlit and empty. Above and below the channel, dense bundles of fine parallel gold copper traces run horizontally the full width, with a few vias and tiny SMD resistors between them. A faint red rim light on the left edge and a faint green rim light on the right edge. Even and calm across the whole width, no focal object. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no chips.

name: j1-holo
prompt: A projected hologram beam, painted in the same comic-hardware illustration style as the reference: a thin glowing horizontal emitter slit along the very bottom edge of the frame, and rising from it a wide fan of volumetric projected light, fine vertical rays, faint horizontal scanlines and drifting dust specks caught in the light, brightest at the slit and fading to nothing at the top. Pure white light with a faint cyan cast on a pure black background, nothing else in the frame. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no symbols.

name: j3-thin
prompt: Same board as the third reference, same painting, but the frame is a very wide thin strip of it: one long straight horizontal light-guide channel, recessed, edged with thin polished gold rails, filled with clear dark resin, unlit, its height only one twelfth of the frame height, running the full width exactly through the vertical centre. Above and below it, bundles of fine parallel gold copper traces run horizontally the full width, tightly packed, with small vias and a few tiny SMD resistors. Faint red rim light at the left edge, faint green rim light at the right edge, one warm key light from above. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no chips.
